notes.title: Version 1.1 Controller Support Added
notes.content:
Controller Support has been added to the main game and will be coming to the Demo Build soon.




If you are having issues with controllers working make sure steam input is turned off. Otherwise please email the support email at pregorgames.help@gmail.com
